claims.text: In the SGX Mainboard Rule 711A version displayed for 1 January 2026 onwards, an issuer must provide its annual sustainability report to shareholders and SGX when issuing its annual report; where it has conducted external assurance on the sustainability report, the rule permits issuance within five months after financial year-end. That annual-report timetable does not resolve a separate immediate-disclosure question under Mainboard Rule 703.

claims.text: SGX Mainboard Rule 711B(3) requires internal review of an issuer's sustainability reporting process. Its second sentence permits additional independent external assurance of the report; that sentence does not itself make the additional assurance mandatory.

claims.notes: AI-prepared textual summary only; independent HUMAN review outstanding. Paragraph 5.3 of the guidance qualifies whether already assured aspects need further internal review under a risk-based approach. This proposition does not establish that external assurance is optional under every applicable law or instrument, nor determine whether any issuer's process meets the requirement. No liability or remedy is inferred. The fact that report contents appear correct, or that an external assurance report exists, is not itself evidence that the required internal review occurred. A risk-based decision under Practice Note 7.6 paragraph 5.3 and any contemporaneous review records must be separately examined; none is supplied here.
